review_scope: Source and grammar review of all remaining direct msg/msgt/msgf callsites in cmd-cave.c and cmd-pickup.c. No C/Rust/catalog integration or build/browser execution.
template_convention: english and japanese use the identical declared named placeholders. original_english preserves the exact source printf format or literal; original_call preserves exact C provenance. Descriptor placeholders are typed semantic snapshots, never finished English output.

excluded: Item-selection prompts and help passed through other APIs
Text emitted by called chest/trap/attack/drop routines
Other files, help, settings, errors, dynamic names and full-game flows

review_notes: This is a migration manifest, not a runtime catalog and not a claim of complete Japanese translation. Existing 44 static semantic IDs and both existing locale JSON files remain unchanged.

All simulation decisions, RNG consumption, sound categories, feedback gates, original English formatting and descriptor side effects must retain their upstream paths when these entries are eventually integrated.
Japanese clauses use ゴールド for currency, がれき for rubble, 掘削用の道具 for diggers, and 罠 in surrounding terminology. Concrete named entities require consistent separate catalogs.
Do not translate usernames, user inscriptions or other external text. Do not send undisclosed state just to make translation easier.
